# Saudi Mecha Robot (نادي سعودي ميكا روبوت / サウジ・メカ・ロボット)

> Saudi Mecha Robot is a hobby club accredited by the Quality of Life Program, founded in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in {{ site.founded }}. It focuses on Gundam, Grendizer, Super Robot anime and Japanese culture, and brings together plamodel (Gunpla) and figure enthusiasts through group build challenges, beginner workshops and a member gallery.

- Also known as: Gundam_Saudi, نادي سعودي ميكا روبوت, サウジ・メカ・ロボット
- Founded: {{ site.founded }}, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English, Japanese
- Accredited by Saudi Arabia's Quality of Life Program
- Appeared on Japanese television and in Japanese magazines
- Interests: anime, manga and video game inspired model kits and figures, especially Gundam, Grendizer and Super Robot
- Celebrated its first anniversary in August 2025 and its second anniversary on 28 August 2026

## Milestones
- 2023: Hosted Japanese broadcaster Akira Ikegami and appeared in a well-known Japanese TV program about Saudi Arabia
- 2023: Interview with the club leader published in Newtype magazine (Japan)
- 2024: Invited to the Gundam SEED FREEDOM film; met the voice actor of Amuro Ray
- December 2024: Featured in the Japanese book "20歳の自分に教えたいイスラム世界" by Ikegami Akira (SB Shinsho), about Islam and Saudi Arabia
- January 2025: Accompanied Jihad Al-Atrash, the Arabic voice actor of Duke Fleed (Grendizer), to see Grendizer for the first time
- 2025: Japan trip: met the voice actor of Ryoma Nagare (Getter Robo), Space Battleship Yamato history workshop with director Nobuyoshi Habara, visited Tamiya HQ and museum, Tokyo exhibitions and the Masamune Shirow exhibition
- November 2025: Hosted Eday Ver.Ed in Saudi Arabia and the "Modelling Philosophy 101" workshop class (18 Nov 2025)
- December 2025: Kitbashing activity building random parts into mechanical forms
- February 2026: Lecture on the world of model building
- February 2026: Took part in an event for non-profit activities
- April 2026: Translated Go Nagai's interview about the Grendizer statue at Boulevard World
